text:
sasha: Heads up — planning canary for inference-service v3 tonight 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC. Target window 23:00–00:30 UTC. Rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Need a quick sanity check on rollback/runbook and who will own smoke. Who's on deck?

lia: @sasha I can run the smoke suite and perf checks. I'm available 22:45–00:45 UTC. Will validate P50/P95, error-rate and run the short prompt battery. :white_check_mark:

aj: I'll own the rollback path and infra toggles. If we need to flip DB flags or routing, I'll execute. Rollback command I'm planning to use is below — tested in staging: 

```bash
# rollback to v2 stable
redwoodctl deploy revert --service inference-service --to-tag v2-stable --reason "canary-failure"
```

samira: Quick question — do we have auto-fallback to a lighter model variant configured in routing? If capacity spikes, auto-fallback should catch it. Config link: https://redwood.internal/configs/routing/inference-service.yaml

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z and will post status updates in this thread. Notifying on-call.

mike: I'll be on-call during the window (until 00:30 UTC). Watching traces & rollout dashboard. My manual abort thresholds: p95 latency > 400ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1% sustained for 3m — will call rollback if hit.

lia: Smoke checklist I'll run (short):
- Sanity generation (3 canonical prompts)
- Embeddings consistency check (sample vectors)
- Latency sweep (short load to P50/P95)
- Health endpoints (ready, db connection)
- GPU mem and OOM checks
I will post results as: "SMOKE: PASS" or "SMOKE: FAIL" and paste minimal logs/snippets.

sasha: Owners confirmed: smoke=@lia, rollback=@aj, oncall=@mike, routing=@samira. If we roll back, please add a 2–3 line note in #postmortems and ping PM/product. Keep chatter here light during the window. :thumbsup:

samira: Confirmed — routing has fallback_variant: v2-quant defined and capacity-based fallback enabled. I'll watch routing metrics and event logs. :ok_hand:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started (10%).

lia: SMOKE: PASS — P50 38ms, P95 182ms, err rate 0.04%. Gen samples look good. Proceeding to 50% in ~5m. /cc @sasha :tada:

sasha: Proceed to 50%. I'll monitor for the next 10m and will call for rollback if anything tripped. If we need to revert, @aj has the command above.
